Small hoops.
Specific details.

Check the inner diameter, closure and material of each component separately. An ear-post description does not establish the composition of the entire hoop. Confirm whether any weight figure refers to one earring, one pair or the complete set.

Questions before choosing

Are the listed sizes inner or outer diameters?

The description identifies them as inner diameters. Do not treat those numbers as the overall outer size or infer hoop thickness from generated photos.

Does a silver post mean an all-silver earring?

No. The listing makes separate statements about the post, base metal and plating. We keep those component descriptions separate and do not claim that the entire earring is sterling silver.

Can the weight be confirmed?

Not from the conflicting figures reviewed here. Request the weight per earring or per pair for the selected variant before relying on a comfort comparison.

Is the sensitive-ear claim verified?

The seller makes an allergy-suitability claim, but this review has no independent evidence establishing it. We do not publish it as a FUBAO guarantee.

The product-page price is a historical Amazon reference from October 25, 2026, converted at ¥150 = US$1. AI-styled images are not measurement evidence. No orders or payments are accepted.
